主要内容: On January 22, 2013, the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC) received a preliminary settlement agreement term sheet (Term Sheet) from ACC Staff regarding Tucson Electric Power Company (TEP)'s pending rate case. The Term Sheet outlines key terms of a proposed settlement, including an increase in non-fuel base rates over adjusted test-year revenues of approximately $76 million and an authorized return on equity of 10.0% based on the actual test-year equity/debt capital structure of 43.5%/56.5%. TEP and ACC Staff support the provisions in the Term Sheet, though it does not address certain aspects of the rate case, such as rate design, which are still under discussion. The Term Sheet is attached as Exhibit 99.1. TEP anticipates that ACC Staff will present the Term Sheet and the status of settlement discussions to the ACC Commissioners at a meeting on January 23, 2013. If a settlement agreement is reached, the procedural schedule includes filing the agreement on February 4, 2013, followed by direct and responsive testimony, and hearings before the ACC Administrative Law Judge (ALJ) starting on March 6, 2013. If no agreement is reached, TEP would file rebuttal testimony on February 4, 2013, and intervenors would file surrebuttal testimony. The Form 8-K filing by UNS Energy Corporation and Tucson Electric Power Company outlines the timeline for a legal proceeding related to a potential settlement agreement. The testimony was scheduled for February 25, 2013, with a rejoinder testimony on March 1, 2013, and hearings before an ACC ALJ beginning on March 6, 2013. The ACC ALJ will issue a recommended opinion and order following the conclusion of hearings, which is subject to approval by the ACC. TEP cannot predict whether a settlement agreement will be entered or approved by the ACC. The filing includes a preliminary settlement agreement term sheet as Exhibit 99.1. The report was signed by Kevin P. Larson, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, on January 22, 2013.
